messages:
Eva Chen: Quick heads-up — we're splitting the Python SDK package into two wheels: `redwood-core` and `redwood-extras`. This is to make the core tiny for low-latency server usage and keep optional deps (transformers, tokenizers, heavy extras) out of the base install. RFC + migration guide: https://redwood.internal/rfc/sdk-packaging-split :eyes:
Mike Patel: Nice. Timeline? Deprecation of the old `redwood` package?
Eva Chen: Plan: announce now -> docs + migration guide live next week -> soft-deprecate old `redwood` package (warning on pip installs) in 30 days -> full deprecation (yank and warn in install output) after 90 days. Will coordinate with support and release teams.
Maria Gonzales: For docs: need clear snippets for imports and for CI changes. Example for migration:
```bash
# old
pip install redwood==4.x
# new
pip install redwood-core redwood-extras  # extras optional
# or if you only need core
pip install redwood-core
```
Josh R.: What about pinned images or our docker base images that used `pip install redwood` in CI? We should add compatibility shim for 2 weeks.
Eva Chen: Yes — we will publish a compatibility shim wheel `redwood-compat` that maps to core+extras for a short window and emits a deprecation warning. Ops will remove shim from images after the 30-day soft-deprecate window.
Mike Patel: Docs action items I can pick up: update quickstarts, update code snippets, add migration checklist (function rename, import change), and add a small migration test matrix. I'll open PRs tomorrow.
Maria Gonzales: I'll schedule a docs review rotation — need review within 48 hours of PR. cc @docs-bot to create a checklist.
docs-bot: checklist created: docs/migrations/sdk-package-split.md, snippets updated, quickstart CI examples revised. Reviewers: Maria, Josh, Mike. Deadline: 48h.
Josh R.: Any runtime breaking changes expected? Import paths remain `from redwood import Client` or change to `from redwood_core import Client`?
Eva Chen: Intention: public API stays the same but the package name changes. We'll provide a shim that re-exports old top-level names for the 90-day window. Full migration guide will show both variants.
Mike Patel: Also adding note for dedicated/private customers: if you vendor wheels, please import new wheel or keep shim until you re-vendor. We'll ping accounts before 30-day mark.
Maria Gonzales: Communications: draft email to customers + changelog entry. Release-coordinator, can you add this to the next releases digest?
release-bot: Added to releases digest v2024.11. Targets: hosted API users + enterprise account managers.
Eva Chen: Thanks all. Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987 (WIP). Please focus on migration checklist and CI snippet updates. I'll post a short internal announcement in #announcements tomorrow. :thumbsup:
